round: the month-13 ALLOC route: the lever design F-DESIGN with its adversarial check, the K1 regroup (orchestrator), and the K0, K2 and SHAPE-LOOKUP count runs (role counts-mac, slot A) with a read-only check; 0 boxes

findings.claim: The 7 allocation levers together give about x1.016 A/B at the center (jit x1.017); about x1.000 low and about x1.045 if every high holds.

At the gate the route alone is x1.003 / x1.010 / x1.013 for a transfer t of 0.2 / 0.6 / 0.8. With GC-BUDGET and WIDE-FIX at their centers, the jitless cells pass from t = 0.51; the jit cells fail at every t <= 1 and need about x1.018 more A/B at t = 0.8.

SIMD is a rider, not a gate lever: the SIMD that the plan builds gives about x1.000-1.0025 (L6 SHA bodies <= 0.23% on an old-build share, L3 kernel 0.01-0.02%); all measured SIMD rows sum to about x1.003-1.0045.
Month-13 call of the design: L1 CTOR-FIT is the LEVER-20 pick only at its pick line; the honest plan word is still 'expected NOT RUN'; the month-13 work is the count runs K0-K3 (0 boxes).

K1: on TD-3 box 2 the ep9 handlers hold 71.67% (e-jitless) / 70.62% (e-jit) of cycles; GC 6.15 / 7.18%; alloc entry + slots grow 1.34 / 1.34%; shape and props add with for-in 0.93 / 0.95%; lookup_with 1.01 / 1.04%; sha256 0.37 / 0.35%; libc mem* 0.00 / 0.06%.
K0: store grow = 1,467,508 per TS run at 5c3e1e11 (f-design N1 1,465,706, +0.12%), so L1 does not fall under its low.

K0: allocated bytes, freed cells and GCs hold (H0, 10 GCs): jitless 420,569,136-420,600,112 B, jit 420,579,376-420,583,984 B; freed 3,406,021-3,408,509. The stub-cache hits are now counted as IC hits; the load totals are equal (357,994,202).
K5 rider: the jit build allocates -8,107 B = -0.002% against the jitless build on TS, and the cells by kind are equal (C5): there is no jit-only allocation cut.
K2: a TS run allocates 6.49 M cells and about 420 MB; objects 36.7% of bytes, SLOTS 23.9%, arrays 10.8%; 1,482,899 SLOTS growths (C2).

K2: the chain rule covers 1,369,767 / 1,395,702 / 1,425,582 of 1,481,595 SLOTS growths at ESCAPE_SLACK 0 / 1 / 2. The simulation removes 1,394,109 SLOTS cells and 50,392,848 net bytes = 12.0% at ESCAPE_SLACK 1 (9.6% at 0, 10.4% at 2); 19.85 M out-of-line load hits move in-object.

L1 after K2: ALIVE; the count parts of the pick line are met at ESCAPE_SLACK 1 only; the Mac wall part is not read (K3 decides). Re-estimate x1.005 / x1.010 / x1.018 (GC-BUDGET base x1.005 / x1.009 / x1.016): the center stays under the floor x1.015.
L2 TABLE-MODE is KILLED: 7,544 SHAPEs from keyed adds (line 0.3 M) and 360,310 for-in key visits (line 2 M).

L4 LIST-FIT: part (a) is ALIVE (538,940 zero-argument new Array() calls, line 0.15 M); part (b) is KILLED (288,455 element growths, line 0.3 M). L5 ALLOC-ENTRY is KILLED for M2 (6.49 M cells, line 8 M).

L3, L6, L7 are open: L3 is alive by count (3.406 M freed cells) but K1 does not split the sweep by thread; L6 is alive by K1 (0.37% / 0.35%) but its waited path is not read; L7 is not priced (the fault cost is not measured).
SHAPE-LOOKUP: 6,145,451 lookup_with calls per TS run (C2), 76% not found; a global (shape, key) cache of 1,024 entries hits 90.3% of calls; per-site caches hit 9.9-37.7%.
SHAPE-LOOKUP-CACHE price: x1.006 / x1.007 / x1.008 (bound x1.010) against the floor x1.015: the pick line is not met; it is a set member only.
The line-M read failed because perf annotate crashed (rc 139) on GetNamedProperty in all 3 TD-3 box 2 records; the fix needs a box run and goes to route LINE-M-READ-FIX.

The count check reads the counts as usable; every read holds. Record faults F1-F6: C1 has no raw file; one IC add hit number has no raw source; the census TOTAL (420.4 MB) and its gc-stats line (425.8 MB) differ by 1.3% with no note (the slack-1 fall is 11.8% on 425.8 MB); 'fields added after the constructor' is a near form; the covered count of the L1 row is net cells removed; the 12.0% byte fall is a simulation and is 9.6% at the design default.
